reviews.text: A genuinely lovely evening from start to finish. The room is warm and unhurried, the service is attentive without hovering, and everything we ordered was thoughtfully done. We'll be back.
reviews.author: A regular guest

reviews.text: One of those rare places that feels special without being stuffy. Beautiful space, kind staff, and food that clearly comes from people who care. Highly recommend for a relaxed dinner.
reviews.author: Local diner

reviews.text: We came for an occasion and left planning the next visit. Everything was fresh and made to order, and the whole team made us feel completely at home. Easily a new favorite.
reviews.author: First-time visitor

hero_sub: An inviting room and a seasonal kitchen, where everything is made to order and there's always a seat saved for you.
about: A welcoming neighborhood restaurant built around honest, made-to-order cooking and a warm, unhurried room. Come as you are, settle in, and stay a while.
